_que_es: Armador, hoja E (2026-11-02): los de la UI de los bloques. Base: node tools/render3d/icons.cjs render merge tap steps pad seed base map battle shield --out <carpeta>; python tools/iconsheet.py compose <los 9 png en orden> --out base.png; python tools/imagegen.py generate skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/hud-e-armador.json --ref base.png --quality high --n 1 --out <carpeta>.

ia.prompt: Keep the same 9 objects, in this order: 1) merge: a thick glossy green arrow pointing up, with a small blue ball at its lower left and a small pink ball at its lower right, and a bigger shiny golden ball with a white sparkle at its tip, 2) tap: a cartoon yellow hand seen from the back, with only the index finger straight up; the middle, ring and little fingers folded down into the palm and the thumb folded across them, so exactly one finger is raised and the hand has five fingers in total, a white sleeve cuff, and three short red impact lines above the fingertip, 3) steps: two bright blue sneaker footprints walking diagonally up and to the right, each a rounded sole with five round toes, 4) pad: a round green arcade floor button on a dark gray base with a gold rim, and a shiny gold coin hovering above it, 5) seed: a little mound of brown soil with a light brown seed peeking out and a green sprout with two rounded leaves, 6) base: a small cozy house with cream walls, a red roof, a brown door and two light blue windows, 7) map: a folded treasure map with green land, a blue lake, a dotted red path and a red X, 8) battle: a cartoon sword with a silver blade, a golden crossguard and a blue grip, pointing up to the right, 9) shield: a royal blue shield with a thick golden border and a golden star in the center.
